data.narrative:
Nitricity is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $102.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech players in the same sector and stage, supplemented by 1 public reference point.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $103M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $195M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—yields a median of $1.8B, with a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce divergent signals, reflecting inherent tension between capital-efficiency frameworks and peer trading multiples in a nascent sector. The triangulated range spans $166M (conservative) to $2.0B (peer-derived ceiling), with a median of $973M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Nitricity's capital deployment and unit economics more closely resemble efficient frontier-tech operators or whether stage-matched peer multiples better capture sector risk and growth expectations. Resolution will depend on revenue trajectory, gross margin evidence, and TAM realization relative to the peer cohort.
